setup.gone.title: Setup is complete
setup.gone.lead: This page is only available until the first setup is finished.
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to DBLoom
setup.welcome.lead: A few steps set up this server. Enter the one-time setup token from the server log or the command line to begin. Nothing is saved until the last step.
setup.token.label: Setup token
setup.token.hint: Printed at server start, or run the setup-token command on the server. Valid for 60 minutes.
setup.token.accepted: Token accepted. Continue with the setup.
setup.mode.title: Login mode
setup.mode.lead: Choose how people sign in. This choice is final once setup is complete.
setup.mode.accountLead: People sign in with a DBLoom account (password or passkey, optional second factor) and open database connections from there.
setup.mode.directLead: People sign in with their database account. There are no DBLoom accounts, second factors or saved connections.
setup.mode.final: Changing the mode later needs the migration command on the server.
setup.mode.envNote: If the server environment names a mode (DBLOOM_LOGIN_MODE), it must match this choice after setup, or the server refuses to start.
setup.env.title: Server environment
setup.env.lead: Read-only. These come from the server environment and change there.
setup.env.originMissing: Not set. Account mode needs DBLOOM_PUBLIC_ORIGIN before anyone can sign in.
setup.env.originMismatch: Differs from the address in this browser. Passkeys only work on the public address.
setup.env.keyMissing: Account mode needs the server key (DBLOOM_SECRET_KEY) before anyone can sign in.
setup.env.addressOutside: Your address is outside the administration networks. You may lock yourself out of administration.
setup.env.acknowledge: I understand and want to continue from this address.
setup.env.acknowledgeRequired: Confirm the administration network warning to continue.
setup.site.title: Site settings
setup.site.lead: Every value is prefilled with a safe default. You can finish with them unchanged and adjust them later.
setup.site.fix: Fix the marked fields to continue.
setup.site.name: Site name
setup.site.autofocus: Focus the user name field on the sign-in page
setup.site.graceHint: Time to add a factor after the requirement applies. 0 means at once.
setup.site.breached: Refuse passwords found in a list of leaked passwords
setup.site.profilesHint: Profiles are stored encrypted with the vault passphrase of each user.
setup.site.denyRootHint: Nobody can connect as root through DBLoom.
setup.site.emptyPasswordHint: Off is safer: connections without a password are refused.
setup.admin.title: First administrator
setup.admin.lead: Create the account that manages DBLoom.
setup.admin.leadFactor: Add a second factor. Recovery codes follow for an authenticator app.
setup.admin.savePassword: Save and add a second factor
setup.admin.factorLead: Add at least one second factor. You can add both.
setup.admin.moreFactors: You can add another factor, or finish.
setup.done.title: Setup complete
setup.done.consumed: The setup token is used up. This page now returns 404.
setup.done.directNote: In direct mode people sign in with their database account.
